name: refine_blade
submitted_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ORIGINAL card illustration and the strict EDIT TARGET. The previous pass only swapped characters and looked plain and standard: this pass must feel INVENTIVE, reinterpreting the replaced subject as a specific Persona 3 Reload moment, character or object, while the card stays instantly recognizable at thumbnail size: same silhouettes, same action, same footprint, same camera. Keep the exact background: its palette, large shapes, lighting direction, cast shadows, magical effects, enemies and core objects stay as in Image1 unless this prompt names them. Do NOT redraw the scene, do NOT recolor globally, do NOT move or rescale anything beyond what is stated. Completely remove the replaced Regent parts (old brown/gold four-point hat-head, gold gauntlets, blue robe, armor) with no remnants left behind, and refill the cleared area with the original background shapes. Match the original's rich hard cel-shading: crisp dark outlines, deep near-black occlusion planes, clear midtone and lit planes, material thickness, purposeful small details; no blur, no soft glow, no photoreal rendering. Makoto Yuki's face and head never appear (hands and sleeves only); other characters' faces are allowed. Persona creatures' hands are plump cartoon mittens with no long human fingers. If a named character's design is uncertain, follow the described features, keep the rest simple, and never invent text. Keep important features inside x8-92%, y10-85% (crop-safe). Output: opaque, full-bleed, horizontal 1000x760, no text, letters, numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Never use Pyro Jack, Jack Frost or Pixie in this card. Replace the hand sprinkling stardust at the upper left with the long-fingered white-gloved hand of IGOR (black suit sleeve) sprinkling the glittering dust with a theatrical flourish. Replace the hand gripping the blade at the right with MAKOTO HAND. Keep the horizontal blade, the cyan sparkles falling on it and the purple background. Character and object designs: [MAKOTO HAND] = MAKOTO YUKI's natural warm pale bare hand(s) with black school-blazer sleeve and white shirt cuff (a small red armband only if the upper arm is visible); NO Makoto face, head, hair or neck anywhere, sleeves leave the canvas at the same edges where the original arms did. [IGOR] = IGOR, master of the Velvet Room: very long hooked nose, huge round eyes with tiny pupils, a wide toothy grin, sparse white-grey hair, black suit, white gloves.
Image2 is a design reference ONLY for Makoto's natural bare hand, black school-blazer sleeve and white cuff. Never include Makoto's face, head, hair, neck or portrait framing. The left hand belongs to Igor and is a long-fingered white glove as specified; no Igor face or body is needed.
